inputs.name: RelaySocketAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: Optional header-capable socket constructor used to open relay connections. Defaults to {}; when socket is absent, open uses the global WebSocket constructor.

inputs.name: RelaySocketAdapter.open.url
inputs.description: Relay URL passed unchanged to the selected socket constructor. The adapter relies on the supplied headers for relay credentials.

inputs.name: RelaySocketAdapter.open.headers
inputs.description: String-valued request headers passed to the selected socket constructor as options.headers. The adapter sends relay credentials in headers rather than adding them to the URL.

outputs.name: RelaySocketAdapter.open
outputs.description: RemoteSocket facade around the constructed socket. opened resolves on open and rejects on error; send sends only while readyState is 1, close defaults to code 1000, onMessage forwards only string data, and onClose reports event.code or 1006.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects the returned opened promise when the socket emits an error event, with message “The relay could not be reached.”
